turns.text: Hello, I want to return a print and get the money back. I ordered the wrong size.
Hello, I can help with that. To find your order, please send me the order number (it looks like SC-1234) and the email address you used when you placed it.
The order is SC-3744 and the email is claire.fontaine@example.com.

Thank you, Claire. I found order SC-3744 (Last Lantern, 40x50 cm, delivered 9 November 2026). Because this refund is over our standard limit, I can't file it myself. A colleague will take over now and check the return with you. Catalogue prints can be returned within 14 days of delivery, the customer pays the return postage, and staff must approve the refund.

rule.ro: Printurile din catalog se pot returna în 14 zile de la livrare. Clientul plătește transportul retur. Rambursarea trebuie aprobată de echipă.
rule.en: Catalogue prints can be returned within 14 days of delivery. The customer pays the return postage. Staff must approve the refund.
